entry_points.text: Block controls share group eighteen: key import, generation and preparation as bidirectional exchanges; discard and zone reset for polling queues as simple commands; partition rescan as simple command.

Multiplexed control covers map and program lifecycle, pinning, attachment, test run, identifier iteration, info, query, tracepoint, type format, task query, freeze, batch, link, stats, iterator, bind, token, stream and struct ops bounded by max markers.

exports.text: User kernel contracts for audit control, program loading, block crypto, partitioning, tracing and zoned storage centered on status, rule, key, partition, trace and zone carriers. Zone ioctls share type 0x12 covering report, reset, size, count, open, close, finish and version two report.

Packet filter interface covering instruction encoding, maps, programs, attachments, links, commands, flags, statistics and attribute carrier, with helper numbers generated from a frozen name table ending in a max marker.

hazards.text: Trailing arrays and user pointers need length checks: rule strings by explicit length, zone descriptors by count, trace bytes by length field, partition buffers by separate length; reserved words must be zeroed.

Variable keys, short names and caller sized logs can overrun or truncate with true size differing; zero seed weakens hashing; arena faults may signal; path and token modes reinterpret fields; exclusive hash can deny access; batch counts are in out.

Undersized outputs report required space instead of truncating; true log size can exceed or undershoot supplied size; per program flags rejected on effective queries; unknown clock values must be deduced from direction and socket context.

invariants.text: Feature index valid within range with mask from low five bits; unset user and session identifiers use all bits set. Genmask helpers build contiguous ranges for word, 64 and 128 bit widths from high then low. Trace actions order queue to driver data with cgroup flag; notify uses zero to two with same flag.

Endian from aliases equal to counterparts; run aliases test; storage names alias deprecated forms; public maxima equal sentinels. Path, token and old descriptors gated by flags; effective query forbids per program flags; log true size reports full material. Helper table frozen in favor of kfuncs. Attr and metadata pointers need eight byte alignment with reserved slots kept.

state_machines.text: Tracing setup moves through configured to active to halted; device path buffers hold thirty two and sixty four bytes for the two setup generations.

Cgroup iteration selects unspecified, single, preorder, postorder, upward or immediate children traversal with increasing values from zero; descendant modes include the start while children excludes the parent.

structs.text: Audit status selector uses eight low single bit flags for enabled, failure, pid, rate, backlog, wait, lost and actual wait; failure uses zero to two. Status exchanges fixed u32 sequence with version union and wait times; features carry version plus select, enable and lock words; tty status carries two words; rules carry flags, action, count, syscall mask, field triples and trailing strings. Permissions use one, two, four and eight; message text bounded; netlink offers only read log group.
Aux tags zero to seventeen cover null, ignore, execfd, headers, counts, page size, base, flags, entry, non elf, identifiers, platform, hwcap and clock tick by position.

Key management uses fixed 64 bit address and length pairs with reserved words: import carries raw input and wrapped output, generation carries output only, preparation carries long term input and ephemeral output. Partition control passes operation, flags, length and user address; operations add, delete and resize; descriptor holds 64 bit start and length, number and two ignored name areas.

Trace categories use distinct powers of two promoted by left shift to form combined actions. Records hold magic, sequence, time, sector, length, action, pid, device, cpu and error with wider second generation; setup carries device name, action mask, buffers, range, filter and reserved words.

Zone types use one to three; conditions use zero to four plus thirteen to fifteen with all bits alias for active; reporting uses low bit for capacity and top bit for cached data. Descriptors hold 64 bit start, length, pointer and capacity plus type and state bytes; report header holds start, count and flags with trailing array; range holds start and count.

Registers number zero to ten with limit sentinel; instruction holds opcode, packed destination and source nibbles, signed offset and immediate. Jump tests separate signed and unsigned order; call and exit use fixed codes; atomic exchange combines base with fetch bit. Trie keys pair prefix length with variable tail; storage key pairs cgroup inode with attach type; iterator link info offers map, cgroup and task variants with at most one rule. Stats cover runtime; stack entries pair status with build identifier; object names bounded; stream selectors use one and two. Packet context spans lengths, metadata, addresses, ports and timestamps with stated byte orders; tunnel and transform records hold identifiers, addresses and flags.

Map types span hash, array, program, perf, per cpu, stack, cgroup, least recently used, trie, nested, device, socket, queue, ring and others between unspec and max with storage aliases. Programs cover sockets, probes, traffic control, tracepoints, datapath, perf, cgroup, tunnels and security with refined attach points and persistent link handles. Pseudo markers denote map, value, type and function; update modes select create or update; creation bits cover prealloc, numa, access gates, link, token and overwrite.

Call carrier is large discriminated union requiring eight byte alignment with per command views for create, element, batch, load, pin, attach, test, identifier lookup, info, query, tracepoint, type format, task query, link create with many hook options, link update and detach, stats, iterator, bind, token, stream and struct ops plus signed load tail. Output lengths are in out and report short buffers. Helpers zero to 211 cover maps, packets, sockets, storage, rings, timers and inspection ending in a max marker, frozen for new kfuncs.
